name: 3Paths
source:
It's up to you to decide the fate of 3 girls! What choice will you make in this story of love, friendship and sadness? Adventure through alternate times, incredible locations and the 4th-dimension in this visual novel that gives you a different experience every time you play it again!

[from [url=https://trturist.itch.io/3paths]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三個女孩的命運，由你決定！在這個關於愛情、友誼與悲傷的故事中，你會做出怎樣的選擇？穿行於不同的時間、不可思議的地點與第四維度，每次重玩，這部視覺小說都會帶來不同的體驗！

[摘自[url=https://trturist.itch.io/3paths]itch.io[/url]]
